about_the_game:
🚨 Kuromaku – A VHS-style psychological thriller inspired by Fears to Fathom and Chilla’s Art.
Ordinary routines become your only defense against a creeping, unseen horror in this slow-burn 1990s-inspired nightmare.

About the Game

Left alone in a new house for the weekend, you’ll endure three nights of rising tension as the familiar slowly warps into the unknown. What you do—and how you react—shapes how the story unfolds and which truth you’ll have to face.

  • VHS-Style Horror – A grainy, retro 1990s aesthetic that amplifies the fear of being truly alone.

  • Everyday Routines, Twisted – Cleaning, checking appliances, and running errands move time forward—but also reveal disturbing evidence.

  • Exploration & Discovery – Search rooms, examine objects, and uncover clues that peel back the layers of the mystery.

  • Player Choice Matters – Confront, conceal, or avoid the lurking presence. Each choice has lasting repercussions.

  • Atmosphere That Shifts – Time and mood alter the landscape as you play, turning the mundane into unsettling trials of endurance.

  • Multiple Endings – Decisions across three nights lead to different conclusions, ensuring no two playthroughs feel the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB / AMD RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Designed for gameplay at 1080p, High settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p/1440p, High–Epic settings

Complete Chores Assigned By Your Mother, Uncover Hidden Secrets, And Survive Unsettling Encounters. Objectives Must Be Completed To Progress Further Into The Rich, Unfolding Story.
